title: Define signing and revocation requirements
purpose: Define what must be signed, how revocation is represented and how Production Distro reacts.
scope: Require signed manifests, snapshots, archives, policy packs, adapter packs, image packs and revocation metadata.
Define key rotation and revoked publisher behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Active revoked artifacts show degraded state.
Local-dev exception is explicit and non-promotable.
failure_modes: Revocation metadata is optional for verified channel.
